string.text: Master switch for the skill/XP announcements.
Which heroes to announce for: player only / party members (player party or other lords in the army) / everyone.
Skill XP gains of the same hero and skill within this interval are merged into one message to avoid spam. Default 1 second.
When disabled, skill proficiency XP is not announced.
When disabled, character (total) XP is not announced.
Show remaining XP to the next skill level in parentheses after the skill XP, e.g. +10(990).
Show remaining XP to the next character level in parentheses, e.g. Character XP +300(4500).
